description: This file contains inline functions and macros related to jemalloc internal operations, including CPU affinity, arena data management, and thread cache handling.

methods.name: malloc_getcpu
methods.description: Returns the current CPU ID, asserting that per-CPU arena is available.

methods.name: percpu_arena_choose
methods.description: Selects an arena index based on current CPU, considering hyper-threading and configuration.

methods.name: percpu_arena_ind_limit
methods.description: Calculates the limit of per-CPU arena indices based on mode and CPU count.

methods.name: arena_tdata_get
methods.description: Retrieves thread-specific arena data, with optional refresh if missing.

methods.name: arena_get
methods.description: Gets an arena object by index, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: decay_ticker_get
methods.description: Retrieves the decay ticker for a given thread data index.

methods.name: tcache_small_bin_get
methods.description: Accesses a small bin in the thread cache by bin index.

methods.name: tcache_large_bin_get
methods.description: Accesses a large bin in the thread cache by bin index.

methods.name: tcache_available
methods.description: Checks if thread cache is available for the given thread data.

methods.name: tcache_get
methods.description: Retrieves the thread cache if available.

methods.name: pre_reentrancy
methods.description: Prepares thread for reentrant operations, asserting current context.

methods.name: post_reentrancy
methods.description: Updates thread state after reentrant operation.
